cookie.title: Cookie Policy
cookie.meta_desc: Leader24 Cookie Policy. Learn how we use cookies and tracking technologies.

intro.title: 1. What are Cookies
intro.text: Cookies are small text files that are saved on your device when you visit a website. They are used to make websites work more efficiently, to provide information to site owners, and to offer a personalized user experience.

types.title: 2. Types of Cookies We Use
types.text: We use different types of cookies for different purposes:
list: Essential Cookies: Necessary for the website to function. Without these cookies, the site could not function properly.
Analytics and Performance Cookies: Allow us to count visits and traffic sources to measure and improve the performance of our site.
Marketing and Profiling Cookies: Used to track visitors across websites. The intent is to display ads that are relevant and engaging for the individual user.

third_party.title: 3. Third-Party Tracking Technologies
third_party.text: In addition to our cookies, we use various third-party technologies to analyze site usage, manage tags, and optimize our advertising campaigns. Specifically, we use:

ga.title: Google Analytics
ga.desc: We use Google Analytics to collect anonymous statistical information on site usage by users (e.g., number of visitors, pages visited, time spent).

gtm.title: Google Tag Manager
gtm.desc: We use Google Tag Manager to manage and deploy marketing and analytics tags on our website without having to directly modify the code.

fb.title: Facebook Pixel
fb.desc: The Facebook Pixel allows us to track conversions from our Facebook ads, optimize campaigns, and build targeted audiences for future ads.

tiktok.title: TikTok Pixel
tiktok.desc: We use the TikTok Pixel to measure the effectiveness of our advertising campaigns on TikTok and to better understand the actions users take on our site.

management.title: 4. Cookie Management
management.text: You can control and/or delete cookies as you wish. You can delete all cookies already on your computer and set most browsers to prevent them from being placed. If you choose to block cookies, you may have to manually adjust some preferences every time you visit the site and some services and functionalities may not work.

updates.title: 5. Updates
updates.text: Our Cookie Policy may be updated periodically. We encourage you to regularly consult this page to stay informed about how we use cookies.

contact.title: 6. Contact Us
contact.text: For any questions regarding our Cookie Policy, you can contact us at: info@leader24.ai.

subscriptions.title: 3. Monthly and Annual Subscriptions
list: Monthly Subscriptions: You can cancel your monthly subscription at any time. Access to the service will continue until the end of the current billing cycle. No refunds are provided for partially used months.

Annual Subscriptions: If you cancel an annual subscription within 14 days of the initial purchase, you can request a full refund. After 14 days, cancellation will prevent automatic renewal for the following year, but no refund will be issued for the remaining period.

exceptions.title: 5. Exceptions

list: Failure to use the service during the active subscription period.
Dissatisfaction due to features that were not promised or advertised.
Technical issues due to third parties (e.g., WhatsApp/Meta outages) that are beyond our control, although we will do our best to assist you.
